groups.operation: Report failure to allocate the document URL base during XInclude processing.
groups.capability: Expose XML_ERR_NO_MEMORY through the XInclude context, as read by xmlXIncludeGetLastError.
groups.consequence: The harness may observe an incorrect context error code.
groups.equivalence_reason: Both candidates describe the same allocation failure, context error code, and harness check.

groups.operation: Deliver an XInclude error to a handler registered on the XInclude context.
groups.condition: A context handler is registered and an XInclude error occurs.
groups.capability: Pass the registered handler and its user data through __xmlRaiseError.
groups.consequence: The registered handler may not receive the error and user data.
groups.equivalence_reason: Both candidates describe delivery through the new context-specific handler path under the same registration and error conditions.

groups.operation: Reject local XPointer inclusion during XInclude processing.
groups.condition: XInclude streaming mode is enabled and a local XPointer inclusion is encountered.
groups.capability: Apply the streaming-mode restriction and report XML_XINCLUDE_XPTR_FAILED.
groups.consequence: The local XPointer inclusion may not be rejected with XML_XINCLUDE_XPTR_FAILED.
groups.equivalence_reason: Both candidates describe the same streaming-mode restriction, including the unresolved reader route.
